Fix: keep button enabled (allow tap) but check inside handler, or change button opacity to dimmed without disabling.

rca_of_issue: Pull Weeds feedback message RCA: GardenPlot.tsx sets `weedsDisabled = !interactive || (data.weedsPulledToday && !data.withered)`. ActionBtn uses `disabled={disabled}` on TouchableOpacity and `onPress={disabled ? undefined : onPress}`. This means a disabled button tap is consumed silently. garden.tsx handlePullWeeds check `if (plotData.weedsPulledToday) { showPlayerBubble(...) }` is never reached. Fix: either keep button tappable (remove disabled, only grey visually) or move the feedback to GardenPlot via a callback like onAlreadyDone.
